description: This file defines the NormalForm class in PHP, which is part of the Goteo project. It manages HTML form generation and handling, including form element creation, rendering, and unique ID generation.

classes.name: NormalForm
classes.description: Represents an HTML form with methods for creation, rendering, and managing form elements. Supports dynamic generation of form components and nested children elements.

methods.name: uniqId
methods.description: Generates a unique ID string with a specified prefix using MD5 hashing.

methods.name: getChildren
methods.description: Constructs an array of form element objects from an array of children data, dynamically loading classes based on element types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form object, processes input data, and generates child elements and footer elements.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Convenience method to instantiate a form object and immediately render it.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the form as HTML using a View template.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the rendered form as a string; catches exceptions to avoid errors during string conversion.

methods.name: getMIME
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the form, which is 'text/html'.
